items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they are not going to pay a guy who is like Joe Blow what they pay Wynton Marsalis.

ctx.x: …which aren’t a part of the feature of the average working jazz musician.

No, exactly. The fringe benefits, in other words, or desirable. I'm sure that attracted a lot of people. There were a lot of musicians on staff who could not, let's say, they were not top-flight jazz players and that job was a better job for them then a job that may have entailed them going on the road with the band or something like that. They were better off doing that kind of work and going out on the road because not being a top-flight jazz player, they cannot command higher prices. Nobody's going to pay,…
But, if a Clark Terry does it…
